Includes half t.p.

Title in double line border.

Engraved frontispiece on verso facing t.p.

Includes index.

Head-pieces; tail-pieces; initials.

John Adams Library copy has bookplate: John Adams Library, in the Custody of the Boston Public Library.

John Adams Library copy: minor annotations.

John Adams' signature on title page: "John Adams July 1780."

John Adams Library copy has separate leather square with title embossed inserted into pages 8-9.

John Adams Library copy transferred from the supervisors of the Temple and School Fund. Quincy, Mass., 1894.
